description:
3rd connection. NOTE ON EXECUTION ORDER (verify/lib/batch.mjs's own fixed step-type ordering, confirmed by reading that file): regardless of this array's order, the generated script always runs file-steps, then sh-steps, then cl-steps, then collect-steps. So the true order this connection actually runs in is: (1) both `file` steps (seed the git IFS tree AND, separately, populate real QRPGLESRC/QSRVSRC members - harmless data prep, touches no *MODULE/*SRVPGM object); (2) all `sh` steps - the full git bare/push/clone rehearsal (already CONFIRMED SUCCESS, 1st/2nd connections, unchanged here) plus BUILDMODX, which retargets the still-unresolved SRCSTMF/CCSID experiment at a THROWAWAY module name JUCSRVX (never referenced by any other lesson/manifest) instead of the real, shared JUCSRV, so continued CCSID debugging cannot put that shared dependency at risk again, plus a fresh `od -x` byte dump of both the git-cloned file AND the original seed file for direct comparison; (3) RESTOREMEMBER, a `cl` step using the exact SRCFILE/SRCMBR-based CRTRPGMOD/CRTSRVPGM commands already CONFIRMED SUCCESS in part07-0203-srvpgm, unconditionally rebuilding the real &LIB/JUCSRV via the proven member-based path regardless of whatever BUILDMODX found; (4) CLIENTCHECKCL, a `cl` step (compiled CL wrapper, ADDLIBLE + CALL in the SAME job) testing whether F0702A/F0703A can actually resolve JUCSRV afterward; (5) both `collect` steps.

WHY THIS MATTERS: the 2nd connection's CLIENTCHECK/CLIENTCHECK2 (`sh`-type steps doing `system "CALL PGM(&LIB/F0702A) ..."` with no preceding ADDLIBLE) both got CPD0192 'Service program JUCSRV not found', which the 2nd connection's own manifest description read as proof that CRTSRVPGM's REPLACE(*YES) had deleted the real JUCSRV object before its own compile failed. Re-reading the 1st connection's own collect output, F0702A/F0703A's BOUND_SRVPGM_INFO row for JUCSRV says BOUND_SERVICE_PROGRAM_LIBRARY = '*LIBL' (not a hardcoded library) - meaning F0702A/F0703A resolve JUCSRV via the CALLING JOB's OWN library list at run time, exactly the pattern solutions/05-13/ju0900c-ticket1.clp's own ADDLIBLE and verify/part05-13-tickets/src/za0500h.clp's own ADDLIBLE both exist to satisfy for other programs. A `sh`-step's raw `system(...)` call cannot add &LIB to a later, separate `system(...)` call's library list (each `system()` call is its own separate job, docs/probes.md's own confirmed finding) - so CPD0192 may have been a SCOPING ARTIFACT of the CLIENTCHECK steps themselves, not proof the object was actually deleted. This connection settles the question two ways at once regardless of which explanation is correct: CLIENTCHECKCL tests real resolvability the correct way (ADDLIBLE + CALL, same compiled CL job), and RESTOREMEMBER unconditionally rebuilds JUCSRV via a path with no CCSID/stale-object risk either way, so the shared object ends this connection in a known-good state either way.

Diagnostic added for the still-open SRCSTMF/CCSID question (not urgent anymore, decoupled from the shared object): the 2nd connection's CRTRPGMOD attempt (targeting the real JUCSRV, with TGTCCSID(*JOB) added) got CPE3490 'Conversion error', a DIFFERENT error than the 1st connection's RNS9380 'Unicode CCSID... cannot be used with TGTCCSID(*SRC)' - this progression (rejected-outright -> conversion attempted but failed) is consistent with the git-cloned file being TAGGED CCSID 1208 (confirmed via `ls -S`, both connections) while its ACTUAL BYTES may still be the original EBCDIC bytes the heredoc-write produced for the seed file (docs/probes.md's own established CCSID findings for heredoc-written files) - i.e. a tag/content mismatch introduced somewhere between the heredoc-written seed and the git-checked-out copy. `od -x` on both files settles this directly.

makei's own PATH self-check still failed in the 2nd connection even after `export PATH=/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin:$PATH` was confirmed in effect for that same shell (a `command -v python3.9` on the very next line succeeded) - left unresolved and de-prioritized per advisor's own guidance (no primary source exists for makei at all; that its own troubleshooting message does not accurately diagnose this exact situation is itself a usable, honest finding for 08-02's design - 'general knowledge, unconfirmed exact cause'). Only a minimal re-probe (`--version`) is kept here to see if it behaves any differently after RESTOREMEMBER/CLIENTCHECKCL run in the same connection; --help/build --help are dropped to shorten this already-long connection.

steps.label: PCREPO
steps.cmd: cd "$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/rehearsal" && mkdir -p pc-side && cd pc-side && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git init -b main 2>&1 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git config user.name 'Learner (verify harness rehearsal)' 2>&1 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git config user.email 'learner-rehearsal-no-email' 2>&1 && mkdir -p src/qrpglesrc src/qsrvsrc && cp "$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/seed/src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle" src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle 2>&1 && cp "$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/seed/src/qsrvsrc/jucsrv.bnd" src/qsrvsrc/jucsrv.bnd 2>&1 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git add -A 2>&1 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git commit -m 'initial import: JUCSRV source' 2>&1

steps.label: PUSH
steps.cmd: cd "$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/rehearsal/pc-side" && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git remote add origin "$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/rehearsal/pub400-bare.git" 2>&1 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git --no-pager push origin main 2>&1

steps.label: CLONE
steps.cmd: cd "$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/rehearsal" && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git clone pub400-bare.git pub400-clone 2>&1 && ls -S "$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/rehearsal/pub400-clone/src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle" 2>&1 && echo ---CLONED-BYTES--- && od -x "$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/rehearsal/pub400-clone/src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle" 2>&1 | head -2 && echo ---SEED-BYTES--- && od -x "$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/seed/src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle" 2>&1 | head -2

steps.label: BUILDMODX
steps.cmd:
system "DLTMOD MODULE(&LIB/JUCSRVX)" 2>&1
system "CRTRPGMOD MODULE(&LIB/JUCSRVX) SRCSTMF('$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/rehearsal/pub400-clone/src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle') TGTCCSID(*JOB) REPLACE(*YES)" 2>&1

steps.label: MAKEIPROBE
steps.cmd:
export PATH=/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin:$PATH
echo ---PYTHON3.9-CHECK---
command -v python3.9 2>&1
echo ---MAKEI-VERSION---
makei --version 2>&1

steps.label: RESTOREMEMBER
steps.cmd:
CRTRPGMOD MODULE(&LIB/JUCSRV) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(JUCSRV) REPLACE(*YES)
CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB/JUCSRV) MODULE(&LIB/JUCSRV) EXPORT(*SRCFILE) SRCFILE(&LIB/QSRVSRC) SRCMBR(JUCSRV) ACTGRP(*CALLER) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: CLIENTCHECKCL
steps.cmd:
ADDLIBLE LIB(&LIB) POSITION(*FIRST)
CALL PGM(F0702A) PARM('C00001')
CALL PGM(F0703A) PARM('C00001')

steps.sql: SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJLIB FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB', 'ALL')) X WHERE OBJNAME = 'JUCSRV' ORDER BY OBJTYPE

SELECT PROGRAM_NAME, BOUND_SERVICE_PROGRAM_LIBRARY, BOUND_SERVICE_PROGRAM, BOUND_SERVICE_PROGRAM_ACTIVATION FROM QSYS2.BOUND_SRVPGM_INFO WHERE PROGRAM_LIBRARY = '&LIB' AND PROGRAM_NAME IN ('F0702A', 'F0703A') ORDER BY PROGRAM_NAME
